title: The open conflicts of the arch, auth, privacy, security, gitlab and logs articles are settled by a source or noted with what would settle them
goal: every _conflicts.md entry open on 2026-10-20 whose first topic is under the arch, auth, privacy, security, gitlab and logs articles is closed with a Resolved or Reviewed note that cites the source settling it, the kb's facts reworded or superseded where the census's fresh reading shows them wrong, or carries a note dated 2026-10-21 or later saying what was checked and which source, lab or login would settle it; no fact is deleted

run:
import re, sys
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import kbfacts
L, P, F = 'public/_conflicts.md', ('arch/', 'auth/', 'privacy/', 'security/', 'gitlab/', 'logs/'), '2026-10-21'
N = re.compile(r'\b(?:Looked|Tried|Still open|Resolved|Reviewed|Closed|Narrowed|Partly resolved|Mostly resolved|Superseded):? (20\d\d-\d\d-\d\d)')
C = re.compile(r'(?:^|\s)- (?:Resolved|Superseded|Closed|Reviewed|Partly resolved|Mostly resolved|Narrowed)\b')
es = kbfacts.ledger_entries(L)
kbfacts.link_entries(es)
top = lambda e: (e['explicit'] or e['via_sources'] or ['public/?'])[0].split('/', 1)[1]
left = [e['line'] for e in es if not C.search(e['text']) and top(e).startswith(P) and max(N.findall(e['text']) or ['0']) < F]
print(len(left), 'open', L, 'entries under', P, 'with no note dated', F, 'or later, lines:', left[:25])
sys.exit(1 if left else 0)

notes: Research item (/kb-research, sources read against the census of ST-zpe7qxtv): an entry closes only when a source settles it or it is no source disagreement (Reviewed); one that needs a lab, a login or unpublished information stays open with a dated note (maintaining.md, Conduct for changes). A gap the reading finds goes to _gaps.md under the same topic. Premise on 2026-10-20 (the first check fails): 41 open public/_conflicts.md entries under ('arch/', 'auth/', 'privacy/', 'security/', 'gitlab/', 'logs/') with no note dated 2026-10-21 or later, lines: [179, 187, 200, 376, 380, 418, 432, 437, 562, 613, 615, 619, 620, 624, 634, 638, 667, 671, 727, 754, 758, 762, 763, 766, 767]
